title: Medon
summary: Raleigh names Medon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Medon, who succeeded Codrus at Athens, and after whose name the Medontidae gouerned without regall name. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. X, sig. 301b
